title: Substack posts
description: The posts dataset and the run summary.

dataset.title: Posts
dataset.description: One row per post. Paid rows carry the post fields and billable true; every other row is a free status row with a reason and no post data.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters of the run: requested, postsDelivered, rowsWritten, chargedEvents, deliveredUncharged, deliveredUnverified, chargeUncertain, writeErrors, publicationsEmpty, byStatus, counterMismatch, billingActive, stopReason, datasetNote and firstFailure. It also lands in the default store as RUN_SUMMARY.
